about_the_game:
They thought it’d be easy. Quick money, a fun adventure, a nice holiday if you will. Put on the scuba gear, hop in, swim through a few wrecks and a few ruins, avoid the sharks, pick up an old soggy antique or two, drop it in a pawn shop, and just like that they’d have paid off the boat with interest. Then buy a bigger boat, find a deeper wreck, pawn off bigger treasures. Rinse and repeat. All legit, no one would get hurt this time… and all they had to do was dive.

They remember diving in, but not how they woke on the ocean floor, nor why there is only one tank between the two of them. Both agree someone is at fault; neither agrees on who. Each suspects the other. If they weren’t tethered to the same old leaky tank, they would probably kill each other right there… but the air is low, the light is scant, and even without the sharks they are nowhere near safe.

Survival should be simple: just go up. Pass the looming jellyfish, push through the treacherous currents, wind through the maze-like wreckage, and keep clear of whatever put them down here. Worse still, they have to work together, sticking close, passing the tank back and forth when the seaweed chokes the path, trusting each other even while knowing it is the other’s fault they are in this mess, and siphoning stale pockets of air from the depths just to keep their levels up. Maybe, if they are lucky, they can find a few gems and still make payday…

short_description: Breath Bound is a 2D co-op puzzle adventure where two divers share one oxygen tank and have to keep each other alive by scrounging air and navigating the treacherous obstacles of the sea. Every stretch of the journey back to the surface is a small test of coordination, timing and teamwork
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Greek, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
